messages.subject: Harledge IBR - data room and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona, James,

We're underway on the independent business review for Pennine. We have the FY25 numbers and the draft 18-month plan. To hit the 21 November deadline we need: the price-recovery correspondence with the two retail customers, the Tenterden automation final cost report, and the weekly 13-week cashflow model.

Early read: the business is viable - the margin story turns once the 7.2% blended price uplift lands in October.

Duncan Reeves | Partner, Restructuring Advisory | Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
